Add your own Telegram API key

Every user uses their own key, so nothing is shared. Create it once (about 2 minutes): 1) Open my.telegram.org and sign in. 2) Tap API development tools. 3) Create an application (any title, platform Android). 4) Copy the api_id number and the api_hash text and paste them below.
The api_id must be a number and the api_hash must be 32 letters and numbers (0-9, a-f). Please check and try again.
Your key is saved encrypted on this phone only. It is never sent to the developer or to GitHub.
Back up new photos and videos from the chosen folders

Android may delay background backup to save battery. For the best results, allow Memora to run in the background in your phone battery settings. Backup cannot run after the app is force-stopped. Your original photos on the phone are never deleted by backup.

Use this after reinstalling Memora or changing phones. You are signed in to Telegram, so Memora will look for your private backup storage and rebuild your Cloud library from it.

Good to know: you must use the same Telegram account (its two-step password may be needed). If the storage channel was deleted or you lost access to it, it cannot be recovered. Photos that were never backed up cannot be restored. Messages permanently deleted from Telegram cannot be recovered. Recovery is only reported as successful after Memora has verified access to the storage.
